TranscriptionalRegulation/TXREG-PRODUCTION-TOPOLOGY: Production now wires the chromosome port (Stage A+B, dec-007): TxReg reads/writes the state-owned, serialized `_shared_rand_stream_state` RNG leaf via `ChromosomeStore`. TranscriptionalRegulation/TXREG-RNG-PROVENANCE: Autonomous OpenCell now draws from a single, state-owned, serialized `ChromosomeStateRandStream` reconstructed from the chromosome leaf every tick (Stage A+B, dec-007, sole TxReg consumer), preserving the prior draw sequence bit-for-bit under the dec-006 L2.1 replay. It does not yet reproduce Karr's multi-consumer inter-process shared-stream interleaving with other chromosome-binding processes (DNADamage, DNASupercoiling, Replication, ChromosomeCondensation), which requires the Stage E sequential commit owner (DC-9).
TranscriptionalRegulation/TXREG-COPY-REDUCTION: Karr produces a fold-change value for both chromosome copies; OpenCell sends only the primary-copy column to Transcription.
TranscriptionalRegulation/TXREG-INITIALIZATION: Karr pre-binds transcription factors during initializeState; OpenCell starts unbound and first binds during tick one.
